title: Alphabet earnings: Android antitrust fine will demolish Google profit
text: Alphabet earnings: Android antitrust fine will demolish Google profit More As Alphabet Inc. heads into earnings on Monday, the European Union’s $5.07 billion Android antitrust fine levied will ruin the company’s profits for the quarter.
